original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州警方在森林展开搜捕绑架者和匪徒的专项行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州警察局启动专项行动，旨在清剿藏匿于全州森林中的匪徒、绑架者和武装抢劫者等犯罪分子。警察局长谢蒂马·穆罕默德周三在拉菲亚为行动揭幕，随后队伍进入多马地方政府区的阿拉杰森林。他表示，此次行动是执行警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏的指令，以加强安全并恢复持久和平。

location.site: 阿拉杰森林（多马地方政府区）
location.raw_text: Alagye Forest in the Doma Local Government Area of Nasarawa State; Lafia

key_facts.fact: 纳萨拉瓦州警察局启动专项行动，清剿藏匿于全州森林中的匪徒、绑架者和武装抢劫者等犯罪分子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nasarawa State Police Command has commenced a special operation to flush out bandits, kidnappers, armed robbers and other criminals staying in forests across the state.

key_facts.fact: 警察局长谢蒂马·穆罕默德周三在拉菲亚为行动揭幕，随后队伍进入多马地方政府区的阿拉杰森林
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Commissioner of Police in the state, CP Shetima Mohammed, flagged off the operation on Wednesday in Lafia while addressing operatives before moving into Alagye Forest in the Doma Local Government Area of the State.

key_facts.fact: 警方称此次行动是执行警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏的指令，以加强安全并恢复持久和平
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to Mohammed, the exercise is in compliance with the directive of the Inspector General of Police, IGP Olatunji Disu, to enhance security and restore lasting peace in the state.

key_facts.fact: 战术小队、反绑架小组和情报人员已被部署到已确认的热点地区和森林走廊
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He revealed that tactical squads, anti-kidnapping units and intelligence operatives have been deployed to identified flashpoints and forest corridors.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
行动成效及是否抓获或击毙嫌疑人尚未获确认
